question: How long does a Needlejaw need to take a Shellglider?
expectedObservationsText: One Needlejaw in clear water with no food. At 0 s the dish adds one Shellglider in the Needlejaw's own cell (founders never share a cell, so it is added as an ordinary inoculation), within contact reach. A test-only override sets both species' speed to 0, so neither can move: this is an experiment fixture, never an ordinary dish. A Needlejaw needs 4 s of unbroken contact to take a Shellglider; contact that breaks starts the count again.
